arguments.need: I run several AI coding agents on my repos and things get messy: they step on each other's files and I lose track of why changes were made. I want something that queues their tasks, runs them in isolated copies of the repo, and opens pull requests after I approve. It must use the agent CLIs I've already logged into without handing over API keys, keep everything local with no telemetry, and be free and open source.
